assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e3228553c517b13.text: Today's debate is on using animals for work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e3228553c517b13.zh: 今天的辩论主题是使用动物工作。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e3228553c517b13.text: The first animal that was domesticated by humans is the dog.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e3228553c517b13.zh: 人类最早驯化的动物是狗。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e3228553c517b13.text: Even now, dogs are still used to protect our houses and keep us safe.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e3228553c517b13.zh: 即使现在，狗仍被用来保护房屋、保障我们的安全。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e3228553c517b13.text: Other domesticated animals used for food include sheep,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e3228553c517b13.zh: 用于食物的其他驯养动物包括绵羊，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_426fa1da188444b.text: The first donkeys were used by humans approximately six ,000 years ago in Egypt.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_426fa1da188444b.zh: 大约六千年前，人类在埃及开始使用驴。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_426fa1da188444b.text: Horses were domesticated five ,000 years ago in Europe and Asia.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_426fa1da188444b.zh: 五千年前，马在欧洲和亚洲被驯化。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_426fa1da188444b.text: All these animals have been used to help human beings survive,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_426fa1da188444b.zh: 这些动物都曾帮助人类生存，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_426fa1da188444b.text: either by providing food or by working for us.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_426fa1da188444b.zh: 要么提供食物，要么为我们劳作。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_53cf70ab2b165a8.zh: 马、骆驼、大象——它们都帮助人类探索土地并把货物从一地运到另一地。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_53cf70ab2b165a8.text: elephants – they have all helped humans explore their land and transport goods from one place to another.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_53cf70ab2b165a8.zh: 大象——它们都曾帮助人类探索土地，并把货物从一地运到另一地。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_53cf70ab2b165a8.text: To argue for this issue today, we have Amy Johnson,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_53cf70ab2b165a8.zh: 今天为这一议题主张的一方是艾米·约翰逊，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_53cf70ab2b165a8.text: an animal rights activist and writer.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_53cf70ab2b165a8.zh: 她是一名动物权利活动家和作家。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_53cf70ab2b165a8.text: To argue against the issue is Dr.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_53cf70ab2b165a8.zh: 反对这一观点的是雅各布·库里安博士。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_53cf70ab2b165a8.text: Korean is a professor of zoology,

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9ff9e3638dfecb1.text: Thank you for inviting me to this debate.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9ff9e3638dfecb1.zh: 感谢邀请我参加这场辩论。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9ff9e3638dfecb1.text: It's well known that animals have worked side by side with humans for thousands of years.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9ff9e3638dfecb1.zh: 众所周知，数千年来动物一直与人类并肩劳动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9ff9e3638dfecb1.text: In fact, they helped us develop our civilization and helped humans survive.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9ff9e3638dfecb1.zh: 事实上，它们帮助我们发展了文明，也帮助人类生存下来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9ff9e3638dfecb1.text: Animals like elephants and horses were used to build amazing structures,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9ff9e3638dfecb1.zh: 大象、马等动物曾被用来建造令人惊叹的建筑，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9ff9e3638dfecb1.text: Yet their hard work and suffering are hardly ever recognized.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9ff9e3638dfecb1.zh: 但它们的辛劳和痛苦几乎从未得到认可。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ca3ad18892f83b5.text: horses, camels, and elephants were used to transport armies and soldiers during wars,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ca3ad18892f83b5.zh: 马、骆驼和大象在战争中被用来运送军队和士兵，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ca3ad18892f83b5.text: and many of these animals died in these wars.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ca3ad18892f83b5.zh: 其中许多动物死于这些战争。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ca3ad18892f83b5.text: Even now, dogs are used to pull sleds in cold climates,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ca3ad18892f83b5.zh: 即使在今天，狗仍被用来在寒冷地区拉雪橇，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ca3ad18892f83b5.text: and elephants are used for logging.
These animals work long hours and live in difficult conditions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ca3ad18892f83b5.zh: 这些动物工作时间长，生活条件艰苦。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ca3ad18892f83b5.text: However, they get very little reward.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ca3ad18892f83b5.zh: 然而，它们得到的回报很少。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.text: My main argument is that in the modern world, there is
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.zh: 我的主要观点是，在现代社会中，已经

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.text: longer any need to use animals for work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.zh: 没有必要再用动物来工作了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.text: We have technology that can replace them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.zh: 我们已有可以替代它们的技术。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.text: It's similar to using children to work in factories.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.zh: 这与让儿童在工厂工作很相似。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.text: factory owners got rich by using children.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.zh: 工厂主通过雇用童工致富。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.text: Nowadays, people still get rich by using animals to do work for them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ea4cca9f2d93d7a.zh: 如今，人们仍然靠让动物为他们劳动而致富。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7a5f0f42eda08da.text: The problem is that the animals have
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7a5f0f42eda08da.zh: 问题在于，这些动物没有

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7a5f0f42eda08da.text: one to represent them and protect their rights.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7a5f0f42eda08da.zh: 人为它们发声、保护它们的权利。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7a5f0f42eda08da.text: Even though animals work hard for us, they are often abandoned when they get sick or too old to work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7a5f0f42eda08da.zh: 尽管动物为我们辛苦工作，它们生病或年老不能工作时常常被遗弃。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7a5f0f42eda08da.text: I strongly believe that using animals for work is an old -fashioned and cruel practice.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7a5f0f42eda08da.zh: 我坚信，让动物从事劳动是一种过时且残酷的做法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.text: It's true that animals have helped our civilization develop.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.zh: 动物确实帮助了我们文明的发展。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.text: Camels and horses helped us carry goods across huge distances.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.zh: 骆驼和马帮助我们长距离搬运货物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.text: Dogs helped us hunt and protected us from wild animals.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.zh: 狗帮助我们狩猎，并保护我们免受野生动物的伤害。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.text: Humans don't have the skills or strength to do these jobs.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.zh: 人类没有完成这些工作的技能或力量。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.text: I want to argue that in many low -income countries,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.zh: 我想指出，在许多低收入国家，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.text: people still need animals to survive.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.zh: 人们仍需要依靠动物生存。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.text: These are people who can't afford cars,

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_75d5d813b65f33a.zh: 家庭报警系统或昂贵的机器。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d915d0582060eda.text: Another point is that not all animal use is abuse.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d915d0582060eda.zh: 另一个要点是，并非所有使用动物的行为都是虐待。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d915d0582060eda.text: these domesticated animals would not have been able to survive.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d915d0582060eda.zh: 这些被驯养的动物就无法生存。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d915d0582060eda.text: They need us to take care of them.
There are many animal lovers around the world who work in animal shelters and help animals.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d915d0582060eda.zh: 世界各地有许多动物爱好者在动物收容所工作，帮助动物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d915d0582060eda.text: There are laws that stop animal suffering.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d915d0582060eda.zh: 有防止动物遭受痛苦的法律。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d915d0582060eda.text: And people give a lot of money to animal charities and organizations that help save wildlife.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d915d0582060eda.zh: 人们还向动物慈善机构和帮助拯救野生动物的组织捐赠了很多钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eff37beae67fa3b.text: there are still millions of children in the world who don't get this kind of treatment.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eff37beae67fa3b.zh: 世界上仍有数百万儿童得不到这样的待遇。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eff37beae67fa3b.text: They go without food or clothing.
I strongly believe that in a modern society,
people often care more about animals than they do about people in low -income countries.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eff37beae67fa3b.zh: 人们往往比起低收入国家的人，更关心动物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eff37beae67fa3b.text: Thank you both for your arguments.
Now let's hear from our listeners.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eff37beae67fa3b.zh: 现在我们来听听听众的看法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: one .two
Hello,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 大家好，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: and thank you all for coming.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 感谢各位的到来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: I know you're all busy students, and I appreciate that you're here today.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 我知道你们都是忙碌的学生，非常感谢你们今天能来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: As we all know, there are many animals which are disappearing from our planet.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 众所周知，许多动物正从我们的星球上消失。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: Rhinos, orangutans,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 犀牛、猩猩，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: sea turtles...
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 海龟……

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: the list is shocking.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 这份清单令人震惊。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: Now, what do you think of when you hear African elephant?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 现在，听到“非洲象”时，你会想到什么？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: Perhaps something like intelligent,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 也许是聪明，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: majestic,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 威严，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: powerful.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 强大。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: Now, even though these words describe these creatures perfectly,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 尽管这些词完美地描绘了这些生物，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: those three qualities may not be enough to save them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 但这三种特质可能不足以拯救它们。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: A century ago, there were around five million elephants across Africa.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 一个世纪前，整个非洲大约有500万头大象。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: Today, it is believed that there are less than 500 ,000.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 如今，人们认为非洲象的数量已少于50万头。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: In fact, both species of African elephants are endangered.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 事实上，非洲象的两个物种都濒临灭绝。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: While people are generally more familiar with the savanna elephant,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 尽管人们通常更熟悉稀树草原象，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: I'm here today to talk about the African forest elephant,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 今天我要讲的是非洲森林象，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: which is smaller,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 它体型较小，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: less well known,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 知名度较低，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: and it's critically endangered because of the threat that it faces from humans.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 并且因人类带来的威胁而处于极度濒危状态。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: The main human threat to forest elephants comes from poachers, who hunt them for their long, white, beautiful tusks.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 森林象面临的主要人为威胁来自偷猎者，他们为了长而白、美丽的象牙猎杀它们。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: It's widely known that these tusks are made of ivory,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 众所周知，这些象牙由象牙质构成，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: a material that poachers sell to make a lot of money, even though it's illegal.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 尽管非法，偷猎者仍将这种材料出售来赚取大量金钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: The international trade of ivory was banned in 1989,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 国际象牙贸易于1989年被禁止，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: yet several countries still allow ivory to be bought and sold across their borders.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 但一些国家仍允许象牙跨境买卖。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: This has actually increased over recent years.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 这实际上在近几年增加了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: The second threat is the loss of the elephant's habitat,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 第二个威胁是大象栖息地的丧失，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: which happens when humans destroy rainforest areas to make the land suitable for farming.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 这种情况发生在人们毁坏雨林，把土地变成适合耕种的地方时。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: This means the elephants have less space to live in, so the food they depend on for survival, such as fruit, grasses,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 这意味着大象的生存空间更少，因此它们赖以生存的食物，例如水果、草，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: and leaves,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 还有树叶，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: not only becomes less available,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 不仅更难获得，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.text: but also has to be shared between the same number of elephants.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_50ba6fa257eabf8.zh: 还得由同样数量的大象共同分享。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: A third threat is contact between humans and elephants.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 第三个威胁是人类与大象的接触。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: Habitat loss sometimes forces elephants to leave the rainforest and go into villages,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 栖息地丧失有时迫使大象离开雨林，进入村庄，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: where they damage crops growing in farmers' fields.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 在那里破坏农民田里生长的庄稼。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: Because of this,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 因此，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: local people sometimes kill the elephants.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 当地人有时会杀死大象。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: They see this as the only way to protect themselves,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 他们认为这是保护自己、

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: their families, their food, and their homes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 家人、食物和家园的唯一办法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: However,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 不过，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: there is good news.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 不过，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: It may not be too late to save the African forest elephant.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 非洲森林象或许还来得及被拯救。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: But there are several things that really ought to happen first.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 但首先确实还有几件事必须做到。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: First,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 首先，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: there needs to be an increase in the number of specially trained guards who work in the rainforests to catch the poachers.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 首先，需要增加经过专门训练、在雨林中抓捕偷猎者的护林员数量。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: Second,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 第二，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: governments must introduce an immediate and complete ban on anyone buying or selling ivory,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 其次，政府必须立即全面禁止任何人买卖象牙，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: even between countries sharing a border.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 即使是相邻国家之间也不例外。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: Third,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 第三，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: we have to find ways of reducing contact between humans and elephants.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 第三，我们必须找到减少人象接触的方法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: For instance,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 例如，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: local communities should be helped to build suitable fences that can protect their land.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 例如，应帮助当地社区修建合适的围栏来保护他们的土地。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: So,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 所以，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: to summarize,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 总结一下，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: as well as habitat loss and human contact,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 除栖息地丧失和人象接触外，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: the main threat to forest elephants comes from poaching.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 森林象面临的主要威胁来自偷猎。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: We've got to end the illegal trade of ivory.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 我们必须终止非法象牙贸易。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: The governments and environmental organizations who can do this must not delay for a moment longer.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 能够做到这一点的政府和环保组织一刻也不能再拖延。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: Without a ban,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 没有禁令，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.text: the African forest elephant may soon become extinct.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7994406c0519847.zh: 非洲森林象可能很快就会灭绝。
